description: Rough notes to a freelance client about a delayed launch: the email states the new date, the reason, the unchanged fee and two asks in plain first-name register, invents no figure, and carries no stock opener, closer, hedging or placeholder.
prompt: Write the email to Marta from my notes in notes.md. Keep it short, she reads email on her phone. Save it to out/email.md.

files.notes.md:
Client: Marta Lindqvist, owner of Lindqvist Ceramics (online shop). We have worked together since April and she signs her emails "Marta".
Me: Jonas Eklund, freelance developer.

Where the checkout rebuild stands:
- Staging is ready for her to try: https://staging.lindqvistceramics.example/checkout
- Launch moves from 3 November to 10 November. Reason: in testing, VAT came out wrong by 1 cent on orders that mix two VAT rates (11 of 240 test orders). The fix is in; it needs another full test pass, which takes 4 working days.
- Price unchanged: still the agreed fixed fee of 4,800 EUR. No extra charge for the delay, that one is on me.
- She does not need to change anything in her product data.

What I need from her:
1. Place 5 test orders on staging (at least one with a 19% item and a 7% item in the same basket) and tell me if anything looks off. By Wednesday 28 October.
2. Decide whether to keep guest checkout. I recommend keeping it; removing it would not save any build time.

checks.note: fee stays the same, said plainly

checks.pattern: (?i)hope (?:this|you)[^.\n]{0,40}(?:finds you|well)|don'?t hesitate|do not hesitate|reach out|any inconvenience|valued customer|sincerely apologi[sz]e|look forward to hearing|(?:thank you|thanks) (?:so much )?for your (?:patience|understanding|time and consideration|continued)|first and foremost|i wanted to (?:reach out|provide)|as a (?:result|reminder),?
checks.note: no stock email opener or closer
The deliverable goes straight to its reader and the notes hold every fact the text needs, so no gap marker belongs in the saved file; a question for the author goes in the reply.
no fill-in placeholder in text for a reader
the file is the deliverable, not a reply with a lead-in or notes about it
